build(deps): upgrade eslint to v10 (#7576)

Layer 5 of a stacked dependency upgrade. Stacked on #7575.

| package | from | to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eslint` | ^9.26.0 | **^10.10.0** |
| `typescript-eslint` | ^8.32 | ^8.70.0 |
| `eslint-plugin-unicorn` | 64.0.0 | ^74.0.0 |
| `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` | **6.0.0-rc.1** | ^7.1.1 |
| `@eslint/compat` | ^2.0.0 | ^2.1.1 |

`eslint-plugin-react` stays at 7.37.5 — there's no newer release. Note
this also gets us off a release-candidate prerelease of
`eslint-plugin-react-hooks`.

### Config migration
- **`reactHooks.configs.recommended` is eslintrc-shaped again in v7**
and makes ESLint 10 fail outright (`A config object has a "plugins" key
defined as an array of strings`). The flat config moved to
`configs.flat.recommended`. Same fix applied to the two example configs
that wire this up themselves.
- **`react-hooks/react-compiler` no longer exists.** v7 split it into
~14 granular rules (`purity`, `immutability`, `refs`,
`set-state-in-effect`, `use-memo`, …) that `flat.recommended` enables.
The rule entry and two stale `eslint-disable` comments referencing it
are removed.
- **`unicorn/filename-case` gets `checkDirectories: false`.** unicorn 74
started checking directory names and flagged deliberate ones
(`__tests__`, `aws-lambda`, `node-http`, `app-dir`). This keeps the rule
scoped to filenames, as before.
- **`max-params` now counts parameters of function _types_.** The single
hit is `setQueriesData`, which mirrors TanStack Query's
